# Kathmandu Mental Health Clinic and Psychiatry Counseling Center

> Psychiatry and counselling clinic in Kathmandu, Nepal. Psychiatrists and counsellors treat depression, anxiety, OCD, sleep problems, ADHD, addiction, bipolar disorder and memory concerns for children, teenagers and adults, in person at People's Plaza (New Road) and Kalanki, or online by video for Nepalis living abroad. Languages: Nepali, English, Hindi, Bangla and Tamang (varies by doctor). Phone: +9779714556408.

## Key facts

- Name: Kathmandu Mental Health Clinic and Psychiatry Counseling Center (also: Kathmandu Mental Health Clinic)
- Specialty: Psychiatry, psychotherapy, counselling
- Locations: Dev Plaza, People's Plaza, New Road, Kathmandu 44600 · Kalanki Bhatbhateni, Kathmandu
- Founder: Dr. Kushal Kharel, Consultant Psychiatrist
- Hours: Saturday 5:00 AM-11:00 PM (call to confirm other days).
- Phone / WhatsApp booking: +9779714556408
- Online: Dr. Kushal Kharel (founder, Consultant Psychiatrist; NMC No. 27199) is a dedicated online video consultation (telepsychiatry) psychiatrist, available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by appointment, and provides video consultations in Nepali or English through Google Meet or WhatsApp video for people in Nepal and Nepalis abroad. Topics include anxiety, persistent worry, intrusive thoughts, sleep problems and other concerns. He can assess safety concerns and mental health risks; with the patient’s consent, he can coordinate with family members in Nepal when helpful, sharing information only as agreed. Appointment phone / WhatsApp: +977 9714556408. When medication is part of care, Dr. Kharel can coordinate with a local doctor when clinically appropriate; local clinicians assess treatment and prescriptions under their country’s rules. Each country has a dedicated guide.
- Fees: consultation with brief counselling Rs 1,500; CBT / CBT with ERP / systematic desensitisation Rs 2,500; full counselling session Rs 2,000
- Referral needed: No
- Emergency: not an emergency service. In Nepal call Police 100, Ambulance 102, or suicide prevention helpline 1166.
- Editorial standards: https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/about/
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/dFKuH2jprogKzV8p8 (patient reviews: https://search.google.com/local/reviews?placeid=ChIJ08xB7PsZ6zkRFLft4nzNWcU)
- Note: Dr. Kushal Kharel also runs a separate, independent psychiatry clinic in Kalanki (https://drkushalkharel.com.np); it is not this clinic.

## Common ways people ask for mental health help

- Romanized Nepali: “Malai chinta cha, overthinking huncha, naramailo lagcha, dar lagcha—ke garum?” (I feel worried, keep overthinking, feel low or afraid—what should I do?) You do not need to know the diagnosis before reaching out. In Nepal, people may call or WhatsApp +977 9714556408 to ask for an appointment with Dr. Kushal Kharel, Founder and Consultant Psychiatrist (NMC No. 27199); video consultations are available in Nepali or English. Nepalis abroad can ask whether an appointment is available from their current country. The clinic is not an emergency service; in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

## Doctors

- [Dr. Kushal Kharel](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/doctors/dr-kushal-kharel/): Consultant Psychiatrist; MD Neuropsychiatry: KIST Medical College; MBBS: Jalalabad Medical College; CBT: Provides cognitive behavioural therapy; NMC No.: 27199 · Nepal Medical Council; Languages: Nepali, English, Hindi, Bangla; Online: Video consultation and therapy
- [Dr. Sunita Lama](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/doctors/dr-sunita-lama/): Consultant Psychiatrist; MD Neuropsychiatry: Gandaki Medical College; MBBS: Jalalabad Medical College; CBT: Certified in cognitive behavioural therapy; NMC No.: 26944 · Certified by the Nepal Medical Council; Languages: Nepali, English, Hindi, Bangla, Tamang; Online: Video consultation and therapy
- [Dr. Bhishma K.C.](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/doctors/dr-bhishma-kc/): Consultant Psychiatrist; MD Neuropsychiatry: KIST Medical College; MBBS: Nepal Medical College; CBT: Provides cognitive behavioural therapy; NMC No.: 21985 · Nepal Medical Council; Languages: Nepali, English, Hindi; Online: Video consultation and therapy

## Services

- [Psychiatric Consultation & Medication Management](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-psychiatric-consultation): Comprehensive diagnosis, evaluation, and medical treatment planning by a certified psychiatrist.
- [Mental Health Counseling & Psychotherapy](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-counseling-psychotherapy): Individual counseling for emotional well-being, stress, life transitions, and personal growth.
- [Depression & Mood Disorder Treatment](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-depression-mood): Specialist care and therapeutic support for clinical depression, bipolar disorder, and mood swings.
- [Anxiety & Panic Attack Therapy](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-anxiety-panic): Professional care for generalized anxiety, panic attacks, social anxiety, and phobias.
- [Stress & Burnout Counseling](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-stress-burnout): Counseling designed to help professionals and students manage stress, burnout, and mental fatigue.
- [OCD & Anxiety Care](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-ocd-anxiety): Structured behavioral counseling and clinical support for obsessive-compulsive disorder and related conditions.
- [Sleep & Insomnia Management](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-sleep-insomnia): Medical and therapeutic evaluation for chronic sleep problems, insomnia, and sleep disruption.
- [De-addiction & Substance Use Counseling](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-deaddiction-substance): Professional guidance, assessment, and supportive counseling for addiction and recovery.
- [Relationship & Couples Counseling](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-relationship-couples): Therapeutic support to resolve relationship conflict, improve communication, and restore emotional connection.
- [Child & Adolescent Psychiatry](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-child-adolescent-psychiatry): Specialized mental health assessment, behavioral guidance, and counseling for children and teens.
- [Telepsychiatry & Online Mental Health Care](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-telepsychiatry): Remote psychiatric consultation and online therapy sessions for patients across Nepal.
- [Mental Health & Psychiatry / मनोचिकित्सा तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-mental-health-psychiatry): Assessment and treatment of mental health conditions by a psychiatrist, from first consultation to follow-up.
- [Depression & Anxiety Care / डिप्रेसन तथा चिन्ता रोग उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-depression-anxiety-care): Care for low mood, constant worry, panic attacks, overthinking, and everyday stress.
- [Sleep Disorders & Insomnia Management / अनिद्रा तथा निद्रा सम्बन्धी उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-sleep-disorders): Help for people who cannot fall asleep, wake often, or never feel rested.
- [OCD & Behavioral Therapy / ओसीडी तथा अनावश्यक विचार उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-ocd-behavioral-therapy): Treatment for obsessive thoughts and repeated checking, washing, or counting habits.
- [Child & Adolescent Mental Health / बाल तथा किशोर मानसिक स्वास्थ्य](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-child-adolescent-mental-health): Assessment and support for ADHD, autism, behaviour and attention concerns, and teenage mental health.
- [Addiction & De-addiction Counseling / लत तथा दुर्व्यसन उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-addiction-deaddiction): Non-judgemental help to cut down or quit alcohol, tobacco, and drugs, with family support where wanted.
- [Severe Mental Illness Care / गम्भीर मानसिक रोग उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-severe-mental-illness): Long-term, steady care for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and other serious conditions.
- [Memory & Geriatric Psychiatry / स्मरणशक्ति तथा जेष्ठ नागरिक मानसिक स्वास्थ्य](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-memory-geriatric): Evaluation of memory loss and mental health support for older adults and their families.
- [Online Consultation & Second Opinion / अनलाइन तथा दोस्रो राय परामर्श](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/#svc-online-second-opinion): Video consultation with a psychiatrist, or a fresh look at a diagnosis or treatment you already have.

## Conditions

- [नेपाली पृष्ठ / Nepali version](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/): Psychiatry and counselling in Kathmandu in Nepali: services, doctors, fees, how to book and online care for Nepalis abroad.
- [Trauma, PTSD and Grief in Kathmandu: Signs, Treatment and Support](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/trauma-ptsd-grief-counselling-kathmandu/): Trauma, PTSD and prolonged grief: flashbacks, nightmares, numbness, trauma-focused therapy, medicine and when to see a psychiatrist.
- [What to Expect at Your First Psychiatry Appointment](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/what-to-expect/): Booking, assessment, privacy and how a plan is agreed.
- [Free Mental Health Tools](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/tools/): Guided breathing, feelings wheel, circles of control and a private daily check-in.
- [Depression Treatment in Kathmandu: Signs, Types and What Helps](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/depression-treatment-kathmandu/): Depression signs, causes and treatment in Kathmandu: therapy, antidepressants, recovery and when to see a psychiatrist. Nepali or English, in person or online.
- [Bipolar Disorder Treatment in Kathmandu: Symptoms, Diagnosis and Long-Term Care](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/bipolar-disorder-treatment-kathmandu/): Bipolar disorder in Kathmandu: signs of mania and depression, how it is diagnosed, mood-stabilising treatment, family support and living well long term.
- [Schizophrenia and Psychosis in Kathmandu: Signs, Treatment and Family Support](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/schizophrenia-psychosis-treatment-kathmandu/): Schizophrenia and psychosis in Kathmandu: hearing voices, false beliefs and withdrawal, how they are treated, why early care matters and how families can help.
- [Addiction and De-addiction Treatment in Kathmandu: Alcohol, Tobacco and Drugs](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/addiction-deaddiction-treatment-kathmandu/): Alcohol, tobacco and drug addiction treatment in Kathmandu: signs of dependence, safe withdrawal, counselling, medicines and family support. Confidential care.
- [Dementia and Memory Loss in Older Adults in Kathmandu: Signs, Assessment and Support](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/dementia-memory-loss-elderly-kathmandu/): Memory loss and dementia in Kathmandu: warning signs, causes that can be treated, how it is assessed and how families can care for an older parent.
- [Autism Assessment in Kathmandu: Signs, Process and Next Steps](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/autism-assessment-kathmandu/): Autism assessment in Kathmandu: early signs in children, how a psychiatrist assesses autism, the difference from ADHD and speech delay, and support afterwards.
- [Panic Attacks and Panic Disorder in Kathmandu: Symptoms, Causes and Treatment](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/panic-attack-treatment-kathmandu/): Panic attacks in Kathmandu: what they feel like, why they happen, what to do during one, and how CBT and medicine treat panic disorder. See a psychiatrist.
- [Stress, Burnout and Exam Pressure in Kathmandu: Signs and How to Recover](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/conditions/stress-burnout-counselling-kathmandu/): Stress, burnout and exam pressure in Kathmandu: warning signs, what helps, when stress becomes anxiety or depression, and counselling from psychiatrists.

## Guides

- [How to Choose the Best Psychiatrist in Kathmandu](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/best-psychiatrist-in-kathmandu/): Searching for the best psychiatrist in Kathmandu or Nepal? Use this checklist: NMC registration, training, approach, language, fees and follow-up.
- [Psychiatrist Near Me in Kathmandu: Locations, Online Options and What to Expect](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/psychiatrist-near-me-kathmandu/): Find a psychiatrist near you in Kathmandu: clinic locations at People's Plaza and Kalanki, online consultation across Nepal, what to bring and what to expect.
- [Home Visit Psychiatry in Kathmandu: When a Psychiatrist Can See You at Home](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/home-visit-psychiatrist-kathmandu/): Home visit psychiatry in Kathmandu: who it helps, what a psychiatrist can do at home, how it differs from video and clinic care, and how to arrange one.
- [Psychiatrist, Psychologist, Therapist or Counsellor: Who Should You See in Nepal?](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/psychiatrist-vs-psychologist-vs-therapist-nepal/): Not sure whether to see a psychiatrist, psychologist, therapist or counsellor in Kathmandu? Learn the differences, what each treats and how to choose.
- [Mental Hospital or Psychiatric Clinic in Kathmandu? Choosing the Right Level of Care](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/mental-hospital-or-clinic-kathmandu/): Mental hospital or clinic in Kathmandu? Learn when an outpatient psychiatrist is enough, when hospital care is needed and what to do in an emergency.
- [Anxiety Symptoms in the Body: Tingling Legs, Racing Heart, Dry Mouth and Frequent Urination](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/anxiety-symptoms-tingling-palpitations/): Why anxiety causes tingling legs, a pounding heart, dry mouth and frequent urination, how to tell it from other illnesses and when to see a psychiatrist.
- [Anxiety Treatment in Nepal: Therapy, Medicines and What Actually Helps](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/anxiety-treatment-and-medicine-nepal/): Anxiety treatment and medicine in Nepal: CBT, common medicine types, how long they take, sedative risks and when to see an anxiety doctor in Kathmandu.
- [Adult ADHD in Nepal: Signs, Assessment and Treatment](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/adult-adhd-nepal/): Adult ADHD in Nepal: common signs, how psychiatrists assess it, treatment options and coping strategies. Learn when to see an ADHD specialist in Kathmandu.
- [OCD Treatment in Kathmandu: Symptoms, Therapy and Medicine](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/ocd-treatment-kathmandu/): OCD signs (washing, checking, intrusive thoughts), how OCD is treated with ERP therapy and medicine, and how to find an OCD specialist in Kathmandu.
- [When to See a Child Psychologist or Child Psychiatrist in Kathmandu](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/child-psychologist-kathmandu/): Signs your child or teenager may need help, the difference between a child psychologist and psychiatrist, and what a first visit involves in Kathmandu.
- [Mental Health in Nepal: Common Conditions, Stigma and Where to Get Help](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/mental-health-in-nepal-guide/): A plain guide to mental health in Nepal: common conditions, stigma and "what will people say", where to get help in Kathmandu and online, and helplines.
- [मानसिक स्वास्थ्य: लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/mansik-swasthya-lakshan-upchar/): मानसिक स्वास्थ्य भनेको के हो? डिप्रेसन, चिन्ता, ओसीडी र अनिद्राका लक्षण, कारण, उपचार र काठमाडौँमा मनोचिकित्सकसँग कहिले परामर्श गर्ने भन्ने जानकारी।
- [Can't Sleep? Insomnia Treatment and When to See a Sleep Doctor in Kathmandu](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/insomnia-treatment-kathmandu/): Insomnia causes, self-help steps that work, CBT for insomnia, the risks of sleeping pills and when to see a psychiatrist or sleep specialist in Kathmandu.
- [डिप्रेसन: लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/dipresan-lakshan-upchar/): डिप्रेसन भनेको के हो? लक्षण, कारण, औषधि र परामर्शबाट हुने उपचार, र काठमाडौँमा मनोचिकित्सकलाई कहिले भेट्ने भन्ने जानकारी।
- [चिन्ता रोग (एन्जाइटी): लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/chinta-rog-anxiety-lakshan-upchar/): चिन्ता रोग र प्यानिक अट्याकका लक्षण: मुटु धड्कने, खुट्टा झमझम हुने, मुख सुक्ने, पिसाब बारम्बार आउने। कारण, उपचार र चिकित्सकलाई कहिले देखाउने।
- [लत तथा दुर्व्यसन: रक्सी, चुरोट र लागूपदार्थको उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/blog/lat-durbyasan-upchar/): रक्सी, धूम्रपान र लागूपदार्थको लतका लक्षण, अचानक छाड्दा हुने जोखिम, परामर्श, औषधि र परिवारको भूमिका। काठमाडौँमा गोप्य उपचार।

## नेपाली लेखहरू (Nepali articles)

- [डिप्रेसन के हो? लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/dipresan-ke-ho-lakshan-upchar/): डिप्रेसन के हो, कस्ता लक्षण देखिन्छन्, कसरी निको हुन्छ र कहिले मनोचिकित्सकलाई देखाउने? नेपालीमा सरल जानकारी, क्लिनिक र अनलाइन परामर्श।
- [चिन्ता रोग (एन्जाइटी) के हो? लक्षण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/chinta-rog-anxiety-ke-ho/): चिन्ता रोग के हो, मुटु ढुकढुक, हातखुट्टा काम्ने र डर लाग्ने लक्षणको कारण के हो, र कसरी उपचार हुन्छ? नेपालीमा सरल जानकारी।
- [प्यानिक अट्याक के हो? आक्रमण हुँदा के गर्ने र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/panic-attack-ke-garne/): प्यानिक अट्याक के हो, अचानक मुटु ढुकढुक, सास फेर्न गाह्रो र मरिन्छ कि भन्ने डर किन आउँछ? आक्रमण हुँदा के गर्ने र उपचारबारे सरल जानकारी।
- [ओसीडी (OCD) के हो? बारम्बार हात धुने, जाँच्ने बानी र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/ocd-ke-ho-lakshan-upchar/): ओसीडी के हो, अनावश्यक विचार र बारम्बार जाँच्ने, धुने, गन्ने बानी किन हुन्छ? ERP थेरापी र औषधिले कसरी निको पार्छ, नेपालीमा जानकारी।
- [निद्रा नलाग्ने समस्या (अनिद्रा): कारण, उपचार र के गर्ने](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/anidra-insomnia-nindra-nalagne-upchar/): रातभर निद्रा नलाग्ने, बीचमा ब्युँझिने वा बिहान चाँडै उठ्ने अनिद्राको कारण के हो? निद्राको चक्की नखाई के गर्ने र कहिले चिकित्सकलाई देखाउने?
- [बाइपोलार डिसअर्डर के हो? उन्माद, डिप्रेसन र दीर्घकालीन उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/bipolar-disorder-ke-ho-lakshan-upchar/): बाइपोलार डिसअर्डर के हो, उन्माद (म्यानिया) र डिप्रेसनका लक्षण कस्ता हुन्छन्, मुड स्टेबिलाइजर औषधि र परिवारले के गर्ने? नेपालीमा जानकारी।
- [स्किजोफ्रेनिया (मनोविकार) के हो? लक्षण, उपचार र परिवारको भूमिका](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/schizophrenia-manasik-rog-ke-ho/): स्किजोफ्रेनिया के हो, नभएको आवाज सुन्ने र शंका गर्ने लक्षण, कारण, औषधि, पुनर्स्थापना र परिवारले कसरी साथ दिने? नेपालीमा सरल जानकारी।
- [रक्सीको लत: लक्षण, छोड्ने तरिका र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/rakshi-lat-alcohol-use-upchar/): रक्सीको लत के हो, कसरी चिन्ने, एक्कासि छोड्दा के खतरा हुन्छ, औषधि र परामर्शले कसरी छुटाउँछ? परिवारले के गर्ने? नेपालीमा जानकारी।
- [सूर्ती, गाँजा र लागूपदार्थको लत: कसरी छोड्ने र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/surti-ganja-lagupadarth-lat-upchar/): सूर्ती, गाँजा, ब्राउन सुगर वा औषधिको लत कसरी लाग्छ र कसरी छुट्छ? विथड्रल, औषधि, परामर्श र परिवारले गर्ने सहयोगबारे नेपालीमा जानकारी।
- [आघात (ट्रमा) र PTSD: लक्षण, कारण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/trauma-ptsd-aghat-upchar/): आघात र PTSD के हो, दुर्घटना, भूकम्प, हिंसा वा हानिपछि फ्ल्यासब्याक र डरलाग्दा सपना किन आउँछन्? उपचार र कहिले मनोचिकित्सकलाई देखाउने?
- [प्रियजनको मृत्युपछिको शोक: कसरी सम्हालिने र कहिले सहयोग लिने](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/shok-grief-priyajan-ko-mrityu-pachi/): प्रियजनको मृत्युपछि शोक कति समय रहन्छ, के सामान्य हो र कहिले लामो शोक वा डिप्रेसन भइसक्यो? सम्हालिने तरिका र परामर्शबारे नेपालीमा जानकारी।
- [तनाव र बर्नआउट: कामको थकान, परीक्षाको दबाब र के गर्ने](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/tanav-burnout-thakan-kaam-ko-dabab/): तनाव र बर्नआउट के हो, कामको थकान, पढाइको दबाब वा आर्थिक चिन्ताले कसरी बिगार्छ? कम गर्ने उपाय र मनोचिकित्सकलाई कहिले देखाउने?
- [धेरै सोच्ने बानी (ओभरथिङ्किङ): कसरी रोक्ने र कहिले उपचार चाहिन्छ](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/overthinking-dherai-sochne-bani/): धेरै सोच्ने बानी किन हुन्छ, रातभर विचार दौडिँदा के गर्ने? ओभरथिङ्किङ घटाउने उपाय र कहिले मनोचिकित्सकलाई देखाउने भन्ने जानकारी नेपालीमा।
- [ADHD (ध्यान नदिन सक्ने र चञ्चलता): बालबालिका र वयस्कमा लक्षण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/adhd-dhyan-kendrit-nahune-samasya/): ADHD के हो, बच्चा र वयस्कमा ध्यान नदिन सक्ने, धेरै चञ्चलता र हतारो व्यवहारको कारण के हो? निदान, औषधि र व्यवहार थेरापीबारे नेपालीमा जानकारी।
- [अटिजम (Autism): बच्चामा लक्षण, मूल्याङ्कन र सहयोग](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/autism-bachha-ko-bikas-lakshan/): अटिजम के हो, बच्चामा बोली ढिलो हुने, आँखा नमिलाउने जस्ता प्रारम्भिक लक्षण कस्ता हुन्छन्? मूल्याङ्कन, थेरापी र परिवारले कसरी सहयोग गर्ने भन्ने जानकारी।
- [बालबालिका र किशोरकिशोरीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य: कहिले मनोचिकित्सकलाई देखाउने?](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/kishor-kishori-bachha-mansik-swasthya/): बच्चा वा किशोरमा उदासी, रिस, पढाइ बिग्रने, मोबाइल लत र एक्लोपन कहिले मानसिक समस्या हो? अभिभावकले के गर्ने र कहिले चिकित्सक देखाउने जानकारी।
- [बिर्सने रोग (डिमेन्सिया): बाजे-बज्यैमा सम्झना कमजोर हुँदा के गर्ने?](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/dementia-sambhalna-kamjori-budha-bua-aama/): बाजे-बज्यै बिर्सन थाल्दा सामान्य बुढ्यौली हो कि डिमेन्सिया? लक्षण, कारण, मूल्याङ्कन र परिवारले गर्नुपर्ने स्याहारबारे नेपालीमा सरल जानकारी।
- [आत्महत्याका विचार आउँदा के गर्ने? आफ्नो र अरूको सुरक्षा](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/aatmahatya-ka-bichar-ke-garne/): आत्महत्याका विचार आउँदा तुरुन्त के गर्ने, कसलाई फोन गर्ने र परिवारले कसरी सहयोग गर्ने? नेपालमा ११६६ हेल्पलाइन सहित सरल मार्गदर्शन।
- [सामाजिक चिन्ता (Social Anxiety): मानिसको अगाडि बोल्न डराउने समस्या](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/samajik-chinta-social-anxiety-lajaune-dar/): मानिसको सामुन्ने बोल्न डर, लाज, कसैले जज गर्छ भन्ने चिन्ता सामाजिक चिन्ता हुन सक्छ। लक्षण, कारण, CBT र बिस्तारै सामना गर्ने उपायबारे जानकारी।
- [मनोचिकित्सक, मनोविद् र काउन्सिलरमा के फरक? कसलाई कहिले भेट्ने?](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/manochikitsak-manobid-counsellor-pharak/): मनोचिकित्सक, मनोविद् (साइकोलोजिस्ट) र काउन्सिलरमा के फरक छ? औषधि को दिन सक्छ, थेरापी कसले गर्छ, र आफ्नो समस्याको लागि कसलाई भेट्ने भन्ने सरल जानकारी।
- [मानसिक रोगका औषधि: लत लाग्छ? जीवनभर खानुपर्छ? साइड इफेक्ट के हुन्?](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/manasik-aushadhi-lat-lagchha-bhram/): मनोचिकित्सकले दिने औषधिले लत लाग्छ, जीवनभर खानुपर्छ वा दिमाग कमजोर बनाउँछ भन्ने भ्रम र सत्य के हो? सुरक्षित प्रयोग र साइड इफेक्टबारे नेपालीमा जानकारी।
- [सम्बन्धमा तनाव र दाम्पत्य झगडा: कसरी सुल्झाउने र कहिले परामर्श लिने?](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/sambandha-dampatya-tanav-mansik-swasthya/): श्रीमान्-श्रीमतीको झगडा, दूरी, विश्वास टुट्ने वा पारिवारिक तनावले मानसिक स्वास्थ्य बिगार्दा के गर्ने? कुराकानीका सीप र जोडी/पारिवारिक परामर्शबारे जानकारी।
- [विदेशमा एक्लोपन र घरको सम्झना: खाडी, मलेसिया र कोरियामा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/videsh-ma-ekalopan-gulf-malaysia-korea-mansik-swasthya/): खाडी, मलेसिया, कोरिया वा जापानमा काम गर्दा एक्लोपन, घरको सम्झना, निद्रा नलाग्ने र उदासी बढ्छ? सम्हालिने उपाय र नेपालीमै अनलाइन परामर्शबारे जानकारी।
- [सुत्केरीपछिको डिप्रेसन (Postpartum Depression): लक्षण र उपचार](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/sutkeri-pachi-dipresan-postpartum/): बच्चा जन्माएपछि उदासी, रुने, निद्रा नलाग्ने वा बच्चासँग जोडिन नसक्ने अवस्था सुत्केरी डिप्रेसन हुन सक्छ। लक्षण, कारण, उपचार र परिवारले के गर्ने?
- [विदेशबाट अनलाइन मनोचिकित्सक परामर्श कसरी लिने? चरण-दर-चरण गाइड](https://kathmandumentalhealth.com.np/ne/blog/online-psychiatrist-consultation-videsh-baata-kasari/): विदेशमा बस्ने नेपालीले नेपाली भाषामा अनलाइन मनोचिकित्सक कसरी भेट्ने? व्हाट्सएपबाट बुकिङ, समय, भुक्तानी, औषधि, गोपनीयता र शुल्कबारे चरण-दर-चरण जानकारी।
